findings.notes: The image verification cache keyed a prior pass verdict on the image reference string, which could be a bare tag. Because a registry can repoint a tag, a verdict earned by one image could later be served for a different image pushed to the same tag. Fixed by refusing to store or serve any cache entry whose reference is not digest-pinned, and by resolving the digest before deriving the key.

The validating webhook trusted the verify-images annotation written by the mutating webhook, so a request that set the annotation directly, or replayed it on UPDATE, was admitted without verification. Fixed by having the validating handler re-verify independently; the annotation is now informational only and is no longer read as a verdict.

Unchecked type assertions on remote attestation and OCI manifest JSON panicked on a non-string type field, bypassing image verification and crash-looping the reports controller. Fixed by reading those fields through a checked accessor that returns an error, so malformed remote data fails closed.

A cosign signing certificate with no subject alternative name caused the configured subject and subjectRegExp identity check to be skipped rather than failing, so a certificate carrying no identity satisfied a policy that pinned one. Fixed by failing closed when a subject constraint is configured and the certificate has no subject alternative name.
